shows.name: Abbott Elementary
shows.overview: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don’t love the school district’s less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

episodes.name: Team Building
episodes.overview: The teachers prepare for the upcoming school year with new faces and big changes on the horizon.

episodes.name: Cheating
episodes.overview: Melissa tries to outsmart her students; Tariq causes chaos in Janine's class; a new guidance counselor joins the school.

episodes.name: Ballgame
episodes.overview: The Abbott crew heads to the ballpark for Teachers' Appreciation Night at the Philadelphia Phillies game.

episodes.name: Game Night
episodes.overview: Gregory steps in to host game night at his apartment. Mr. Johnson, Ava, Barbara and Melissa head to the DMV to renew their licenses.

episodes.name: Camping
episodes.overview: Barbara organizes a Halloween camping trip for older kids.

episodes.name: No Phones
episodes.overview: Abbott Elementary participates in the district’s "No Phones Day" initiative.

shows.name: Talamasca: The Secret Order
shows.overview: Guy Anatole joins the clandestine world of the Talamasca, an international spy agency for the immortal universe, as he searches for answers to his family's own part in the supernatural world.

episodes.name: We Watch. And We Are Always There.
episodes.overview: Guy is recruited to join a top-secret spy organization for the supernatural world. He must choose between his old life in the ordinary world and a new life as an undercover spy. Helen deals with trouble at the New York Mother House.

episodes.name: A Wilderness of Mirrors
episodes.overview: Guy joins the Talamasca, leaving his old life as a lawyer behind. Helen trains him on the ins and outs of undercover work. Guy is sent to London on his first mission - to follow a mysterious hit man.

episodes.name: The Task at Hand
episodes.overview: Guy questions his trust in Helen and the Talamasca in the wake of a dangerous mission. Helen tells Guy the story of the Seven Five Two and its place in the history of the supernatural world. New information comes to light.

shows.ref_name: Anne Rice's Talamasca: The Secret Order

shows.name: Canada's Drag Race
shows.overview: Drag queens showcase their Canadian charisma, uniqueness, nerve, and talent to become Canada's Next Drag Superstar and to win the $100,000 grand prize.

shows.name: Down Cemetery Road
shows.overview: When a child goes missing in the aftermath of a house explosion, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find them. As secrets unravel and a military conspiracy emerges, all hell is unleashed on South Oxford's sleepy suburbs.

episodes.name: Almost True
episodes.overview: A catastrophic event upends South Oxford. Sarah grows suspicious of the emergency response. While investigating, she encounters Zoë Boehm.

episodes.name: A Kind of Grief
episodes.overview: Zoë goes digging for answers as Sarah starts to spiral. Hamza is under pressure to keep a lid on the crisis.

episodes.name: Filthy Work
episodes.overview: Sarah winds up on an unexpected road trip. Zoë begins pulling threads left behind by Joe and suspects something bigger is at play.

episodes.name: My Friends Don't Like Me
episodes.overview: While hiding out, Sarahs learns more about Downey. Zoë ruffles feathers as she seeks new collaborators for her investigation.

shows.name: English Teacher
shows.overview: A high school teacher in Austin tries to balance the competing demands of the students and their parents in a world where the rules seem to change every day.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season 2, Evan still refuses to stay quiet when controversy arises at Morrison-Hensley High. The gang finds themselves in the crosshairs of issues including climate change, Covid, military recruitment and student phone usage. Evan also struggles to keep his relationship with Malcolm separate from his work life. Even though Malcolm no longer works at Morrison-Hensley, Evan’s excessive righteousness at school takes an increasing toll on his romantic life.

episodes.name: Covid in America
episodes.overview: Evan pushes back against the students as they try to modernize the school play.

episodes.name: Trash
episodes.overview: Evan attempts to update the school's waste management system.

episodes.name: Grant's Dinner Party
episodes.overview: Grant invites the teachers to a dinner party at his home.

episodes.name: College Week
episodes.overview: As the students prepare their college applications, Evan starts to question his own hiring.

episodes.name: Evan's Mom
episodes.overview: Evan receives a surprise visit from his mother Elena.

episodes.name: Recruiter
episodes.overview: A military recruiter comes to the school, and the teachers experiment with new classroom phone policies.

episodes.name: Lake Trip
episodes.overview: Evan and Malcolm take a vacation while the other teachers administer standardized tests back at school.

episodes.name: Accreditation
episodes.overview: The teachers get evaluated by outside observers in an effort to earn the school a better rating.

episodes.name: Lock In
episodes.overview: The teachers oversee the school's overnight lock-in.

episodes.name: Graduation
episodes.overview: The teachers try to prevent a student prank from ruining graduation.

shows.name: Ghosts
shows.overview: Samantha and Jay throw caution to the wind when they convert their recently inherited country estate into a bed-and-breakfast. Call it mislaid plans. Not only is the place falling apart, but it’s also inhabited by spirits of previous residents -- whom only Samantha can see and hear.

episodes.name: Soul Custody
episodes.overview: Sam, Jay and the ghosts attempt to extricate Jay from his deal with Elias Woodstone, the devil. Also, Isaac helps Patience through a crisis of confidence and Pete and Alberta navigate the fallout from their kiss.

episodes.name: Viking Wedding
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay try to impress their trendy city friends while a misplaced bookcase threatens Thor's ability to deliver an important speech. Also, Isaac rallies the ghosts to help the couple navigate a tough customer service ordeal.

episodes.name: Halloween 5: The Mummy
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay's Halloween takes a spooky turn when they accidentally unleash a mummy ghost.

episodes.name: Bring Your Daughter To Work Day
episodes.overview: Trevor finds a way to spend more time with his newly discovered daughter, Abby, by getting her at job at Jay's restaurant.

episodes.name: T-Daddy
episodes.overview: Trevor's relationship with his daughter is strained when he pushes her to follow a career in finance over poetry. Meanwhile, Jay confronts labor unrest at the restaurant.

episodes.name: Planes, Shanes, and Automobiles
episodes.overview: Sam and Pete get on each other's nerves during a book tour road trip and things reach a breaking point when an airline strike threatens their ability to get home in time for Thanksgiving.

episodes.name: S05E09
episodes.overview: The annual two-part GHOSTMAS episodes, featuring the yearly holiday possession.

episodes.name: S05E10
episodes.overview: Sam is excited to be interviewed on national TV on Christmas Eve morning, but the opportunity is threatened due to a possession.

shows.name: Happy's Place
shows.overview: Bobbie inherits her father's restaurant and is less than thrilled to discover that she has a new business partner in the half-sister she never knew she had.

episodes.name: I've Got a Secret
episodes.overview: After Bobbie and Emmett’s big moment, Bobbie is still unsure how Emmett truly feels about her, prompting Bobbie to do the unthinkable and give Emmett a birthday gift. Gabby tries to convince Isabella to give her the family discount on Happy’s house.

shows.name: High Potential
shows.overview: Morgan is a single mom with an exceptional mind, whose unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

episodes.name: Pawns
episodes.overview: While working tirelessly to shield her family from the Game Maker's threats, another crime drags Morgan back into his game and the LAPD must decide whether to trust her instincts before the next move turns fatal.

episodes.name: Checkmate
episodes.overview: As the Major Crimes team desperately seek answers amidst a string of unresolved crimes, Morgan suspects the Game Maker is responsible. Meanwhile, Daphne and Oz set out to find Roman, and Elliot prepares a surprise act for his school’s talent show.

episodes.name: Eleven Minutes
episodes.overview: When a man with a troubled past is killed under mysterious circumstances, Morgan and the LAPD uncover a tragic motive behind his death. Meanwhile, Morgan opens up to Ava about her father, forcing Ava to confront truths she isn’t ready to face.

episodes.name: Behind the Music
episodes.overview: An investigation involving the murder of a local singer uncovers details that reopen a strikingly similar decades-old cold case. Later on, the team rallies around Soto after she is passed over for the captain’s chair.

episodes.name: Content Warning
episodes.overview: When a social media stunt turns deadly, Morgan and Karadec head to an influencer content house to track down answers. Meanwhile, the LAPD team adjusts to Captain Nick Wagner's new role, and Ava seeks out more information on Roman’s disappearance.

episodes.name: Chasing Ghosts
episodes.overview: It's almost Halloween, and a wealthy lawyer is found dead in his "haunted" Victorian mansion. As the team investigates the spooky case, Captain Wagner surprises everyone with his skills. At home, Elliot plays mediator between Morgan and Ava.

episodes.name: The One That Got Away (1)
episodes.overview: When a priceless painting is stolen in a museum heist, Morgan and Karadec team up with an art-recovery expert to unravel a tangled case and fierce ownership battle. Meanwhile, Soto is determined to uncover the secrets hidden inside Roman’s backpack.

shows.name: I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here!
shows.original_name: I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here!
shows.overview: Twelve celebrities are abandoned in the Australian jungle. In order to earn food, they must perform Bushtucker Trials which challenge them physically and mentally.
shows.ref_name: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here!

shows.name: IT: Welcome to Derry
shows.overview: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

episodes.name: The Pilot
episodes.overview: As four misfit kids vow to find their missing classmate, Major Leroy Hanlon arrives to a mixed reception at Derry Air Force Base.

episodes.name: The Thing in the Dark
episodes.overview: While Charlotte and Will navigate their new life in Derry, Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

episodes.name: Now You See It
episodes.overview: When a major find yields few clues, General Shaw pushes ahead with his top-secret mission, ordering Leroy and Pauly to escort Dick Hallorann on an aerial search for a new dig site. Meanwhile, Rose attends a tribal meeting about the military presence in Derry, and Ronnie, Lilly, Will, and Rich attempt to get visual proof by conjuring an Orixá.

episodes.name: The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
episodes.overview: After their efforts are rejected by Chief Bowers, the kids must deal with their disappointment...and a series of increasingly terrifying experiences. Meanwhile, as General Shaw escalates his efforts to find answers, Charlotte tries to advocate for a reluctant Hank, who worries his secret will get out. Urged on by the Patty Cakes, Marge pulls a mean-spirited prank on Lilly.

episodes.name: Neibolt Street
episodes.overview: After learning the truth about General Shaw's operation, Leroy decides to move his family to the base for safety. While the tribal Keepers strategize how to contain increased aggression in town, the military descends on Neibolt Street, and the kids head into the sewers with their own objective.

shows.name: Loot
shows.overview: After divorcing her husband of 20 years, Molly Novak must figure out what to do with her $87 billion settlement. She decides to reengage with her charitable foundation and reconnect with the real world—finding herself along the way.

episodes.name: Bye-Bye Mode
episodes.overview: The Wells Foundation team tracks Molly down on a private island to convince her to return—but they're not alone.

episodes.name: Would Hit
episodes.overview: Molly and Arthur go on their first official date. Sofia's chaotic sister Destiny reenters her life.

episodes.name: Lady Molly
episodes.overview: After Molly is deepfaked, she scrambles to restore her reputation by accepting an award at a charity cricket match in England.

episodes.name: Buona Sera
episodes.overview: At Arthur's urging, Molly decides to make peace with her ex-husband. Howard recruits Nicholas and Ainsley to help him impress Destiny.

episodes.name: Joyride
episodes.overview: Molly uses her vast resources to give Nicholas the perfect day, along the way remembering how they first met.

episodes.name: What's Up with Us
episodes.overview: Arthur invites Molly on a birding trip with his friends. Sofia discovers that Howard and Destiny have started dating.

shows.name: Only Murders in the Building
shows.overview: Three strangers share an obsession with true crime and suddenly find themselves wrapped up in one.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: After their beloved doorman, Lester, dies under suspicious circumstances, Charles, Oliver, and Mabel refuse to believe it was an accident. Their investigation plunges them into the shadowy corners of New York and beyond - where the trio uncovers a dangerous web of secrets connecting powerful billionaires, old-school mobsters, and the mysterious residents of the Arconia. The trio discovers a deeper divide between their storied city they thought they knew and the new New York evolving around them - one where the old mob fights to hold on as newer, even more dangerous players emerge.

episodes.name: Nail in the Coffin
episodes.overview: While investigating Lester’s mysterious "accidental" death, the clues lure Charles, Oliver, and Mabel out of Manhattan — and straight into some dangerous new "old" territory.

episodes.name: After You
episodes.overview: A look back at Lester's early days at the Arconia reveals how a young dreamer became a steadfast doorman — sacrificing his future to protect the residents from the building’s secrets.

episodes.name: Rigor
episodes.overview: The trio stumbles upon a crucial piece of evidence... and promptly compromises it. With time running out, they scramble to solve the mystery before the police close in on them.

episodes.name: Dirty Birds
episodes.overview: Snooping goes sideways when three billionaire suspects catch the trio and invite themselves over for an evening at Oliver's.

episodes.name: Tongue Tied
episodes.overview: Thwarted in their investigative podcast plans, Mabel and Oliver look for help from the Arconia support staff — as Charles dines with another suspect and gets caught up in "catching" more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: Flatbush
episodes.overview: The investigation takes Oliver and Loretta back to the streets of his childhood, where buried memories surface and secrets about Lester and Nicky's widows emerge. Mabel and Charles follow leads after a break-in.

episodes.name: Silver Alert
episodes.overview: The mayor warns the trio about the billionaires, sending them to investigate further at a villainous lair upstate — as Oliver boots it in an attempted escape.

episodes.name: Cuckoo Chicks
episodes.overview: Mabel gathers a ragtag group to crash an exclusive ladies night. While trying to save the Arconia from being sold, Charles and Oliver accidentally end up in couples' therapy.

episodes.name: LESTR
episodes.overview: Told through the lens of one annoying robot who may hold the keys to more secrets than anyone realized — the Arconia throws one last party as the residents discover that a killer may still be in their building.

episodes.name: The House Always...
episodes.overview: With the clock ticking, the trio doubles down to bring "new" and "old" forces together to bring down a killer — ending in one explosive showdown and the reveals they've been chasing all season.

shows.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
shows.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

shows.name: Pluribus
shows.overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

episodes.name: We Is Us
episodes.overview: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.

episodes.name: Pirate Lady
episodes.overview: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together…and causes friction.

episodes.name: Grenade
episodes.overview: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

shows.name: Robin Hood
shows.overview: A modern reimagining of the classic tale. After the Norman invasion of England, Rob, a Saxon forester’s son, and Marian, a Norman lord’s daughter, fall in love and unite to fight for justice, challenge corruption, and restore peace to the land.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 12th-century England, Robert of Locksley rises from grief to rebellion. With Marian at his side and outlaws at his back, Rob defies the Sheriff of Nottingham and Norman rule. His fight for freedom will give birth to the legend of Robin Hood.

episodes.name: I See Him
episodes.overview: We meet Robert of Locksley, a young Saxon whose world is shattered by injustice. His struggle to right a personal wrong will forge him into something legendary...not just a man, but a symbol.

episodes.name: A Heinous Devil
episodes.overview: After witnessing his father's brutal execution, a young Saxon forester, Robert of Locksley, begins a dangerous descent into vengeance that will ignite a legend.

episodes.name: No Man Can Hide Forever
episodes.overview: The death of Huntingdon's son deepens the rift between Normans and Saxons. Rob gains a powerful ally in Little John, but the Sheriff's pursuit grows, driving the outlaws deeper into Sherwood. Marian enters the dazzling yet perilous court in Westminster.

episodes.name: The Cause of This Unrest
episodes.overview: Rob and his band target the Sheriff's reward money — a bold heist that could change their fortunes, if it doesn't first get them killed.

episodes.name: Go Back to Them
episodes.overview: Rob risks all to save the Millers from hanging. In Westminster, Marian's world tilts with news of her brother's death.

episodes.name: Bound by Love, Divided by Lies

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
shows.overview: RuPaul has made the trip across the pond in search of a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land.

seasons.name: Series 7
seasons.overview: Rest Easy. Mama's back! Start your engines, as a brand new set of fabulous queens enter the werkroom, hoping to win Mama Ru's seal of approval and take home the crown.

episodes.name: Queens of the Brit Gala
episodes.overview: A hot new cast of queens enter the werk room as RuPaul kicks off his legendary race. Joel Dommett joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Rumble in the Jumble
episodes.overview: Supermodel turned comedy star Michelle de Swarte joins Mama Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the queens take on the iconic Design Challenge.

episodes.name: Battle of the Brats
episodes.overview: The queens take on a hyperpop banger for the Girl Group challenge. Girls Aloud legend Nadine Coyle joins RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Sweety Darlings!
episodes.overview: There’s bonk-busting drama as actor Jane Horrocks joins Ru, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel, and the queens star in an absolutely fabulous acting challenge.

episodes.name: Talent Ahoy!
episodes.overview: The queens take to the high seas for a cruise-themed talent show. Derry Girl Jamie-Lee O’Donnell joins RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: S07E06
episodes.overview: It’s Rusical week! West End musical theatre legend Mazz Murray joins Mama Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the curtain comes down on yet another queen.

episodes.name: S07E07
episodes.overview: Susan Wokoma, Jordan North, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr all join Ru as the queens fight it out to prove they have the best celebrity dating and improv skills on Snatch Me Out!

episodes.name: S07E08
episodes.overview: The queens give drag makeovers to hun legends Diane Parish, Shobna Gulati, Charlotte Church, Michelle McManus, Dani Harmer and David Potts. Mutya Buena joins the judging panel.

shows.name: Shifting Gears
shows.overview: Matt is a stubborn, widowed owner of a classic car restoration shop. When Matt's estranged daughter Riley and her teenage kids move into his house, the real restoration begins.

episodes.name: Secret
episodes.overview: Matt wrestles with his feelings for Eve, and Charlotte convinces him to go to a grief group. Meanwhile, Riley struggles with her own “will she or won’t she” about her feelings for Gabe.

episodes.name: Date
episodes.overview: Matt and Eve go on their first date but have different ideas of what it should entail; Riley befriends the mom of Georgia's new friend; Carter mediates a tiff between Gabe and Stitch.

episodes.name: Passion
episodes.overview: When Carter's job pays more than Riley's, she decides to find her forever career and clashes with Matt over her future; Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias drops by Parker Customs; Matt debates letting go of a piece of the past.

episodes.name: Danger
episodes.overview: When a raccoon appears in the Parkers’ yard, Matt sees a chance to teach Carter a lesson about facing his fears. Meanwhile, Riley struggles to navigate the world of dating apps and goes on her first post-divorce date.

episodes.name: Scary
episodes.overview: Matt plans to spend Halloween with Eve, but the real terror begins when she wants to sleep over. With Carter and Georgia out for the night, Riley invites Gabe and Stitch to a party, hoping to relive the crazy, epic Halloweens of her past.

episodes.name: Loyalty
episodes.overview: Matt's dream build turns into a nightmare when controversy threatens to derail everything.

shows.name: Stranger Things
shows.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 5
seasons.overview: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by the opening of the Rifts, and our heroes are united by a single goal: find and kill Vecna. But he has vanished — his whereabouts and plans unknown. Complicating their mission, the government has placed the town under military quarantine and intensified its hunt for Eleven, forcing her back into hiding. As the anniversary of Will's disappearance approaches, so does a heavy, familiar dread. The final battle is looming — and with it, a darkness more powerful and more deadly than anything they've faced before. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone — the full party — standing together, one last time.

shows.name: The Curse of Oak Island
shows.overview: Follow brothers Marty and Rick Lagina through their effort to find the speculated - and as of yet undiscovered - buried treasure believed to have been concealed through extraordinary means on Oak Island.

episodes.name: The Comeback
episodes.overview: As the Laginas and the team relaunch their search for treasure on Oak Island, a stunning revelation may help prove the Knights Templar were on Oak Island centuries ago

episodes.name: Billion Dollar Baby
episodes.overview: After the team makes an ancient discovery on Lot 5, they learn that the fabled treasure could be worth more than anyone imagined.

episodes.name: Medieval Intentions
episodes.overview: New discoveries in the Swamp and Money Pit area lead to a potentially history-changing revelation for the team.

episodes.name: The Smoking Gun
episodes.overview: As the team drills deeper than ever into the Money Pit area, a find in the swamp could have explosive implications.

shows.name: The Diplomat
shows.overview: Amid an international crisis, a US diplomat contends with her high-profile job as ambassador to the UK and her strained marriage to a political star.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Ambassador Kate Wyler lives the particular nightmare that is getting what you want. She just accused Vice President Grace Penn of hatching a terrorist plot and admitted she's after the VP's job. But now the President is dead, Kate's husband Hal may have inadvertently killed him, and Grace Penn is leader of the free world. None of this slows Hal's campaign to land Kate the vice presidency. Kate steps into a role she never wanted, with a freedom she never expected, an increasingly complicated friendship with Foreign Secretary Austin Dennison, and an unnerving bond with First Gentleman Todd Penn.

episodes.name: Emperor Dead
episodes.overview: Amid a growing constitutional crisis, the staff scrambles to stage an impromptu inauguration, while Hal exploits the chaos behind the scenes.

episodes.name: Last Dance at the Country Club
episodes.overview: Kate weighs a compelling offer. Eidra faces scrutiny over fallout from the Roylin debacle. Stuart pitches a proposal that goes far deeper than policy.

episodes.name: The Riderless Horse
episodes.overview: As the nation pauses to mourn, Grace considers the framework of her administration. Private strain threatens Kate and Hal's polished public image.

episodes.name: Arden
episodes.overview: Kate's unique role grants her access to anyone she wants — except the one person she needs. Dennison puts actionable intelligence to personal use.

episodes.name: Birdwatchers
episodes.overview: Forced to play the perfect couple, Kate and Hal confront a looming problem in international waters and a development that could torpedo U.S. credibility.

episodes.name: Amagansett
episodes.overview: At an emergency strategy session, Grace weighs unthinkable choices, while Kate rolls the dice on a gamble that could alter the course of history.

episodes.name: PNG
episodes.overview: Sequestered inside Winfield House as embassies go on alert and allies fall silent, Kate and Callum race to contain a potential disaster.

episodes.name: Schrodinger's Wife
episodes.overview: Kate must use all her leverage and political instincts to avert a catastrophe at a high-stakes summit — with the fate of nations hanging in the balance.

shows.name: The Last Frontier
shows.overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a lone U.S. marshal's jurisdiction is turned upside down after a prison transport plane crashes in the remote wilderness, setting free dozens of violent inmates, he begins to suspect the crash was not an accident.

episodes.name: Blue Skies
episodes.overview: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

episodes.name: Wind of Change
episodes.overview: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

episodes.name: Country as F**k
episodes.overview: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

episodes.name: American Dream
episodes.overview: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Arnaq
episodes.overview: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

episodes.name: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
episodes.overview: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

episodes.name: Change of Time
episodes.overview: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank’s secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

shows.name: Watson
shows.overview: A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes at the hands of Moriarty, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.

episodes.name: A Son in the Oven
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows spring back into action when Mary’s mother accidentally poisons herself while suffering from a rare form of dementia that is progressing with impossible speed. Meanwhile, Sherlock Holmes resurfaces after being presumed dead.

episodes.name: Back from the Dead
episodes.overview: A microbiology researcher returns from an expedition to Siberia, leading to a possible outbreak of a revived pathogen. Watson reconnects with Sherlock Holmes.

episodes.name: Expletive Deleted
episodes.overview: Watson and the team work alongside Laila to help a patient named Maxine, a 30-year-old who looks 10 years old.

episodes.name: Happy When It Rains
episodes.overview: Watson and the team jump into action when four new patients are brought to UHOP with wounds that appear to be infected with a flesh-eating bacterium following a tornado. Meanwhile, Shinwell searches for meaning as a nursing student and Adam’s wedding to Lauren risks being halted.

episodes.name: Lucky
episodes.overview: While visiting another hospital, Watson becomes convinced that a coma patient is suffering from locked-in syndrome and has been mistaken for a coma patient for over a decade. After the patient is transferred to UHOP for treatment, he shocks the team with chilling messages. Meanwhile, Sherlock is back in town and is staying with Watson.

episodes.name: Buying Time
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows race against time to save the life of Xavier, a 21-year-old athlete with a fast-growing, seemingly incurable cancer. Meanwhile, Mycroft Holmes lets Watson know his team’s work at UHOP may no longer have funding available.

shows.name: Power Book IV: Force
shows.overview: Tommy Egan leaves New York behind and plans to take on Chicago, using his outsider status to break all the local rules and rewrite them on his quest to become the biggest drug dealer in the city.

shows.name: Landman
shows.overview: Set in the proverbial boomtowns of West-Texas and a modern-day tale of fortune-seeking in the world of oil rigs, the series is an upstairs/downstairs story of roughnecks and wildcat billionaires that are fueling a boom so big it’s reshaping our climate, our economy and our geopolitics.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, as oil rises from the earth, so do secrets - and Tommy Norris's breaking point may be closer than he realizes. Facing mounting pressure from M-Tex Oil, Cami Miller, and the shadow of his kin, survival in West Texas isn't noble - it's brutal. And sooner or later something's got to break.

shows.name: I'm a Celebrity... Unpacked
shows.overview: Hosted by Jungle legend Joel Dommett, along with your current King of the Jungle Sam Thompson and Capital radio DJ Kemi Rodgers, the iconic trio debate the day’s Trials, triumphs, tears and stomach growls from the Campmates as they happen.

shows.name: A Man on the Inside
shows.overview: A retired professor gets a new lease on life when a private investigator hires him to go undercover inside a San Francisco retirement home.

shows.name: The Pitt
shows.overview: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

shows.name: Hijack
shows.overview: When Flight KA29 is hijacked during its seven-hour journey from Dubai to London, Sam Nelson—an accomplished corporate negotiator—tries using his professional skills to save everyone on board. Will this high-risk strategy be his undoing?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the second season, a Berlin underground train and its commuters are taken hostage, while authorities scramble to save hundreds of lives. Sam Nelson is at the heart of the crisis on board, where one wrong decision could spell disaster.

shows.name: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
shows.overview: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.

shows.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
shows.original_name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
shows.overview: Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the memory of the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes and dangerous exploits all await these improbable and incomparable friends.
shows.ref_name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

shows.name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
shows.original_name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
shows.overview: A retelling of the Arthurian legend set in a Roman-occupied Britain where barbarian invaders threaten to lay claim to the island.

shows.name: Wonder Man
shows.overview: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: Aspiring Hollywood actor Simon Williams is struggling to get his career off the ground. During a chance meeting with Trevor Slattery, an actor whose biggest roles may be well behind him, Simon learns legendary director Von Kovak is remaking the superhero film "Wonder Man." These two actors at opposite ends of their careers doggedly pursue life-changing roles in this film as audiences get a peek behind the curtain of the entertainment industry.

shows.name: Cross
shows.overview: Alex Cross is a brilliant but flawed homicide detective and full of contradictions. A doting father and family man, Cross is single-minded to the point of obsession when he hunts killers. He is desperate for love, but his wife’s murder has left him too damaged to receive it.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In Season Two, Cross is in pursuit of a ruthless vigilante who is hunting down corrupt billionaire magnates.

shows.name: Dark Winds
shows.overview: This psychological thriller follows two Navajo police officers, Leaphorn and Chee, in the 1970s Southwest as their search for clues in a grisly double murder case forces them to challenge their own spiritual beliefs and come to terms with the trauma of their pasts.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The fourth season focuses on the search for a missing Navajo girl, which takes Leaphorn, Chee and Manuelito from the safety of Navajo Nation to the gritty terrain of 1970s Los Angeles in a race against the clock to save her from an obsessive killer with ties to organized crime.
